summary_en: Interim dividend of 20 yen per share confirmed; year-end dividend raised from 15 yen to 20 yen per share, bringing total annual dividend to 40 yen, up 20 yen from prior year.
title_en: Notice Regarding Modification (Increase) of Interim Dividend and Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 Year-End Dividend Forecast
translation_en_brief:
Suncall Corporation announced an increase to its fiscal year ending March 2027 dividend forecast on November 13, 2026. The interim dividend was confirmed at 20 yen per share with a record date of September 30, 2026, and an effective date of December 10, 2026, totaling 612 million yen. The year-end dividend forecast was revised upward from the previously announced 15 yen per share to 20 yen per share, bringing the total annual dividend to 40 yen per share.

This represents an increase of 20 yen compared to the prior fiscal year (March 2026), when the company paid an interim dividend of 5 yen and a year-end dividend of 15 yen, totaling 20 yen. The revision reflects solid business performance in the current period. The company stated that while shareholder profit distribution is positioned as an important management priority, the dividend policy is formulated by comprehensively considering stable financial footing, future business growth investments, and cash flow preservation, with a basic principle of implementing dividends on a stable and continuous basis.
